cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Choose the biscuits carefully. The winning plate goes to the neighbourhood meeting. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It's also our first impression of the new committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put your name beside the plate so we can test that publicly.

mechanism: A gives B biscuit selection while taking carrying and label work, escalating a snack into committee reputation and publicly named responsibility.
confusable: Unlike merely worrying about food quality, A makes successive choices expose the participants to a wider audience and personal accountability.
comparison: Committee first offering and signed plate differ from a witnessed table-tennis cleanup agreement.
seedUse: D216-b biscuits and neighbourhood meeting; S02-b takes shared responsibility and supporting work as the exposure grows.
